topic: AI Engineer + Data Scientist Interview Mastery
intro: Interview me sirf sahi answer nahi, sochne ka tarika dikhta hai. Is section me wahi classic problems hain jo screening me aate hain — reverse, palindrome, two-sum, anagram, binary search, memoized fibonacci — har ek ke saath complexity aur edge cases.
theory: Pehle problem ko restate karo: input, output, constraints aur edge cases. Interviewer ke saath assumption align karna aadha answer hai.
Brute force se shuru karke complexity batao, phir optimize karo. Direct optimal solution bolna bhi theek hai par reasoning dikhao.
Hash map lookup O(1) se nested loop O(n²) se O(n) hota hai — two-sum aur frequency problems ka core trade-off.
Sorted input par binary search O(log n) deta hai; har iteration me search space aadha karna hai aur boundary conditions carefully likhni hain.
Recursion me overlapping subproblems ho to memoization se exponential se polynomial ho jata hai; stack depth aur base case check karo.

explain: Memoization overlapping recursion ko linear banata hai.
Output ko print se verify karo.
Ye AI Engineer + Data Scientist Interview Mastery ka basic building block hai.
Har step search space aadha karta hai — O(log n).
Ek step aur jodne se behaviour kaise badalta hai, dekho.
Input badal kar edge case test karo.
Stable dedupe order bachata hai aur anagram grouping sorted key par hash map use karti hai.
Ye snippet end-to-end flow dikhata hai.
Output ko project/interview me evidence ki tarah use karo.

realWorld: Two-sum/hash-map pattern duplicate detection, pair matching aur reconciliation me directly use hota hai.
Binary search sirf arrays me nahi, version/commit range aur capacity planning me bhi lagta hai.
Anagram/frequency patterns text dedupe aur data-quality checks me kaam aate hain.

interview.q: Two-sum ka optimal approach kya hai?
interview.a: Ek pass me hash map: har value ke liye target-value pehle dekha gaya hai ya nahi check karo, phir current value store karo. O(n) time, O(n) space.

interview.q: Binary search me off-by-one errors kaise avoid karte hain?
interview.a: Invariant clear rakho: target [low, high] me hai. `while low <= high`, mid ke baad low=mid+1 ya high=mid-1. Har case ke baad space strictly chhota hona chahiye.

interview.q: Memoization aur tabulation me kya chunenge?
interview.a: Memoization top-down hai, recursion + cache — likhna aasan, stack depth concern. Tabulation bottom-up iterative hai, space control better. Overlapping subproblems dono me chahiye.

interview.q: Time complexity batate waqt kya dhyan rakhte hain?
interview.a: Input size ka definition, best/average/worst case, aur space (extra structures). Hash map average O(1), worst O(n) collision par — interview me ye nuance bolna acha lagta hai.

debugging.error: Logic error — pehla do items chahiye the, sirf pehla aaya
debugging.why: Slice ka end exclusive hota hai; 0:1 sirf index 0 deta hai. Ye AI Engineer + Data Scientist Interview Mastery ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.lesson: Slice boundaries exclusive hoti hain — range jaisa hi rule.

debugging.error: TypeError: can only concatenate str (not "int") to str
debugging.why: String concatenation ko dono taraf str chahiye; Python implicit conversion nahi karta. Ye AI Engineer + Data Scientist Interview Mastery ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: f-string ya str() se explicit conversion karo.
debugging.lesson: TypeError type mismatch batata hai — conversion explicit karo.

debugging.error: IndexError: list index out of range
debugging.why: List me sirf 0 aur 1 index hain; 5 par kuch nahi. Ye AI Engineer + Data Scientist Interview Mastery ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: Index se pehle length check karo ya safe getter use karo.
debugging.correct:
scores = [10, 20]
print(scores[1] if len(scores) > 1 else None)
debugging.lesson: IndexError off-by-one aur empty collection ka signal hai.

debugging.why: Dict me score key exist nahi karti; [] missing key par KeyError deta hai. Ye AI Engineer + Data Scientist Interview Mastery ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: get() se default do ya key ki presence check karo.
debugging.lesson: KeyError expected-missing field ka case hai — get/default se handle karo.
